entries.title: Citations and Debate become one mode, Peer review
entries.body: Citations and Debate are combined into one mode, Peer review, and it is no longer behind the Experimental features switch. It opens on Bibliography, the works the piece cites, with Reception and Claims, what others say about it, one press away. Old links to either mode open the matching view. If you have modes prepared when you add an article, its Bibliography is made then too; Reception and Claims are made only when you ask for them.

entries.title: You can delete a question from a conversation
entries.body: Every question after the first in a conversation has a bin button beside it. Press it once to arm it and again to delete that question, its answer and every message after it. The deletion is permanent, and the button is not offered while an answer is still arriving.

entries.title: The Guide can offer to save your reasons
entries.body: When you type to the Guide, it can offer a wording close to your own of why you are reading the piece, or of your About you, as a card under its answer. Nothing is saved until you press Save, and Undo puts the old text back. It is also told not to write its answer again after making an offer, and an answer that pauses partway no longer runs two sentences together.

entries.title: Claims show the works cited beside them
entries.body: In Peer review's Claims view, each claim lists the works cited in the same paragraph of the article, under "Cited in this paragraph". Press a name to open that work in Bibliography. It says only that the two share a paragraph, not that the work backs the claim.

entries.title: A search with many matches holds up the page for less time
entries.body: A search with many matches could freeze the page for a moment while every match was laid out. Each match now shows as plain words first and is formatted as it comes near the screen, so that pause is shorter.

entries.title: Interrupted Illustrated pictures are not painted twice
entries.body: If painting an article's pictures in Illustrated was interrupted, the app could quietly start painting the whole set again. It now stops and shows a message asking you to try again, and trying again paints them as normal.
